name: OPA227 / OPA2227 / OPA4227 / OPA228 / OPA2228 / OPA4228
tagline: Burr-Brown's 3 nV/√Hz OP27/OP37 successor, Tangent's PIMETA default; decompensated OPA2228 prized for resolution.

lineage.note: SBOS110 dated May 1998; positioned to replace OP-27/LT1007/MAX427 (OPA227) and OP-37/LT1037/MAX437 (OPA228).
Revisions A (2005), B (2015), C (2022, current). OPA228 macromodel Rev. A 04/19/02; PSpice models updated June 2022.

part_numbers.note: High grade (75 µV, 0.6 µV/°C max); P DIP-8, U SO-8; trim pins 1/8.
Standard grade (200 µV, 2 µV/°C max); AC and noise specs identical.
High-grade dual, standard pinout, no trim; OPA2227 ACTIVE per TI.
The common CMoy socket part. Marks: DIP 'OPA2227P' + 'A'; SOIC 'OPA' / '2227UA'.
Quad, DIP-14 / SO-14; standard grade only.
Decompensated (G ≥ 5) single, high grade; trim pins 1/8.
Decompensated dual, standard grade: the 'OPA2228' of CMoy shoot-outs.

key_specs.value: 3 nV/√Hz (3 at 100 Hz, 3.5 at 10 Hz); 90 nVpp 0.1–10 Hz
OPA227 2.3 V/µs; OPA228 10 V/µs (11 typ in Rev A table)
key_specs.condition: Rev A inconsistent; Rev C not checked

key_specs.value: ±2.5 V to ±18 V (5–36 V); specified ±5 V to ±15 V
3.7 mA typ, 3.8 mA max (4.2 mA max at −40 to +85 °C)
Isc ±45 mA; swing 2 V from rails (10 kΩ), 3.5 V (600 Ω)
key_specs.condition: Rev A typ; Rev C value not checked

key_specs.value: P/U ±5 typ, ±75 max µV; PA/UA ±10, ±200 µV
Bipolar, bias-cancelled, laser-trimmed; clamp diodes ≤20 mA
key_specs.condition: CMRR 138, AOL 160 dB; ch. sep. 110 dB

reputation.summary: Tangent made the OPA2227 his PIMETA default: like the OPA132/OPA134 without the bass bloom. He found the OPA228 more lively and resolving, but it oscillated at low gain. Head-Fi is split: some call the OPA2227 dull and laid back, others praise the OPA2228 at gain ≥ 5. Japanese reviewers call the OPA2228 flat and high-resolution.
typical_uses: CMoy / PIMETA headphone amps (DIP-8 OPA2227PA / OPA2228PA)
DAC output, line and preamp stages, sources below ~20 kΩ
Op-amp rolling in socketed DIP-8 audio gear
Reference buffering in DIY DACs (e.g. a 2.5 V reference)
caveats: OPA228/OPA2228 needs G ≥ 5: it oscillates at low gain or with capacitive load; a CF fix adds noise.
Input clamp diodes: fast large steps can pass destructive current; keep under 20 mA or risk 'subtle damage'.
Not rail-to-rail: ~2 V headroom (3.5 V at 600 Ω), Isc ~45 mA; marginal from 9 V into headphones.
Bias current is cancelled internally; TI advises against a bias-balancing resistor, which adds offset and noise.
Iq ~3.7 mA per amp hurts battery life; A and non-A grades differ only in DC precision.

counterfeit_notes: No family-specific counterfeit reports. Genuine TI marking: DIP 'OPA2227P' (+ 'A' line for PA); SOIC 'OPA' over '2227U'/'2227UA'. Check slew (2.3 V/µs OPA227, ~10 V/µs OPA228), 3 nV/√Hz noise and ~3.7 mA Iq. Buy authorised.
alternatives: OPA210 / OPA2210 (similar class, not declared successor)

part_numbers_affected: OPA2227 (reported; orderables not itemised in retrieved sources)
silicon_changes.summary: Unresolved lead. A TI E2E reply (thread 1360546) ties an OPA2227 marking change to new-fab PCNs 20230306000.1 and 20220615003.1, implying new silicon. But 20230306000.1 is on no PCN mirror, 20220615003.1 lists only TL07x/TL08x/LF353, and the reply may be boilerplate.
silicon_changes.identification: Newer DigiKey OPA2227 lack the TI logo or use a new format; E2E also cites marking PCN 20211123004.0. No die-revision letters found.

spec_deltas.after: new fab site(s) per PCN 20230306000.1 (site not named; unconfirmed)
TI logo absent / new format (E2E customer report)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown: a new-fab chip could differ in HF behaviour or noise within the same limits. No listener or measurement reports.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: only a marking difference is confirmed; any fab or die change rests on one indirect E2E reply.
silicon_changes.verification: '20230306000' finds only the E2E thread. PCN 20251017000.1A (RFAB, January 2026) is not tied to this family.

revision_history.changes: Initial release; date printed on later revisions. No identified copy; candidates on Octopart (114273), CERN and kontest.ru.
Still Burr-Brown layout, no change log. P/U and PA/UA grades, trim pins 1/8, ±2.5 to ±18 V; OPA228 slew 10 vs 11 V/µs.
New TI template ('OPAx227, OPAx228'). One summary says April 2015, likely an error. Change log not retrieved.
Formatting and Absolute Maximum Ratings updates ('Added dual supply voltage in Absolute Maximum Ratings'). No die or process change indicated.
Simplified-Chinese edition at the ti.com/cn symlinks; reportedly revised March 2023, after English Rev C. No silicon change implied.

revision_chains.note: No revision-confirmed copy of the 1998 original; Burr-Brown layout persisted into Rev A, so layout cannot tell them apart.
Reportedly revised March 2023; ZHCS literature number not seen.

open_questions: What did SBOS110C change beyond formatting and Absolute Maximum Ratings (OPA228 slew, Isc, AOL/GBW)?
Does SBOS110C still show trim on pins 1/8 of the singles? OPA132/OPA627 lost it (diyAudio thread 418419).
Rev B date: June 2015 per copies and PSpice headers, or April 2015 per one change-log summary?
Which revisions do the unlettered mirrors hold, and which copy is the 1998 Burr-Brown original?
Current lifecycle per orderable (all ACTIVE in the 2014 addendum); does PCN20240701000 or any PCN cover this family?
